traveler1.name: Elara
dialogue: Greetings, young leader. The winds carry whispers of your growing settlement.
I have journeyed far and seen much. Perhaps I can offer some guidance.
Beware the shadows that lurk in the unexplored lands...

elder_mira.name: Elder Mira
elder_mira.description: The village elder, keeper of ancient lore.
dialogue: The spirits of our ancestors watch over us.
Remember the old ways, child. They hold the key to survival.
The Great Obelisk... it calls to us. Its power can save us.

hero_aric.name: Aric Stonebeard
hero_aric.description: A brave and resourceful scout, destined for greatness.
dialogue: I'm ready for any challenge, leader!
The wilds hold many secrets, and dangers.
I'll scout ahead and bring back what we need.

scientist_zane.name: Zane
dialogue: Fascinating! The energy readings from this planet are extraordinary!
I believe I can harness this power... for the good of all, of course.
With the right application of science, we can overcome any obstacle!

alien_ambassador.name: Xylar
alien_ambassador.description: An ambassador from a distant star system.
dialogue: Greetings, inhabitants of this world. We come in peace.
We have observed your struggles. Perhaps we can offer assistance.
But know this: the universe is vast, and not all who wander it are friendly.
